Messages.Author: Shawn F. Carnes
Messages.Body:
Sorry I haven't been around in a while--been at conventions and workin'
like a dog on the finishing touches of Sabbat and a couple of other
things. My apologies to all... even as I see 412 messages before me.

I will now attempt to catch up, put out flame wars, and continue in my
tradition of being the hot-headed Irishman of WotC R&D. Donations are
always accepted.
